remarks: Sophisticated Lifestyle at Sought-after In Town location! Popular restaurants, spectacular shopping and riverside park all nearby. Remodeled from top to bottom! Flexible open floor plan with walls of windows overlooking bucolic brook and level lot. Stylish rooms feature curved window wall and wood burning fireplace in living room. Dining area with French doors overlooks lawn. Newly remodeled kitchen with new appliances includes breakfast bar and access to private rear patio by the brook - an ideal spot for your morning coffee! Spacious first floor primary suite includes new full bath. Upper level features 2 Bedrooms, remodeled full bathroom, laundry area and access to private balcony deck. Yearly unfurnished rental available for multiple years. No Smoking. References required.
